Name: Anime Shane Portrait
Author: thecouchwitch
Description:
I saw a fanart by Allie Gunther of Shane, and it was just so [i]Shane[/i] that it inspired me to do a portrait set based on it. Me being the weeb that I am, any art style I try to emulate is going to turn out anime.
Enjoy my mod, and check out the art of the artist who inspired it!

Permission was granted by Allie Gunther to use her art as reference and inspiration.

Installation: 
1. Download mod
2. Extract it into Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits
3. Let it override. Making a back-up of the original is recommended.

[url=http://alliegunther.tumblr.com/post/178957561245/sketches-of-harvey-and-shane-instagram]Allie Gunther's original fanart[/url]﻿
